occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: A caregiver was having their CPR/FA expired since 8/16/2026.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: A caregiver with "Pending" status background check was observed in a classroom with children.     This was corrected when the caregiver was removed from the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Three children files were observed missing the required health statement information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: The Safety Drill documentation was reviewed and observe to be missing the Fire Drill for the month of July  and August.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: Based on the information obtained from the investigation. It was determined that the director did not ensure the operation is in compliance with the Minimum Standards.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: Make Provisions for Training: Based on the information obtained from the investigation, it was determined that the operation failed to provide proper training to the staff members at the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Make Provisions for Training (26 TAC §746.201(3))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Fire Inspection: This standard was recited.     This standard was recited as the operation failed to submit the Fire Inspection report by the compliance date.     The current Fire inspection report was not available for review during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Fire Inspection (26 TAC §746.5103)

occurrences.finding: Basic Requirements for Infants - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants or Toddlers: An infant was observed sleeping with a pacifier clipped to their chest.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants or Toddlers (26 TAC §746.2401(6))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Fire Inspection: The current Fire inspection report were not available for review during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Fire Inspection (26 TAC §746.5103)

occurrences.finding: AP Infants Sleep on Backs or Must Have Completed and Signed Sleep Exception Form for the Infant: A two months old infants was observed sleeping face down in the crib during the inspection.     This was corrected when the infant was turned over during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Infants Sleep on Backs or Must Have Completed and Signed Sleep Exception Form for the Infant (26 TAC §746.2427)

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: Three infants' feeding instructions form were reviewed and observed not current.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: Three infants were observed sleeping in the cribs with stuffed animals and blankets.    This was corrected when the safe sleep hazards were removed from the cribs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: A two months old infants present at the operation did not have the admission information for reviewed during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §746.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Two infants files were reviewed and missing the health statements on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: The operation failed to report the number of employees who have left the operation for 2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training: The pre-service training for one caregiver in the 2-3yo classroom was observed not available for review during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Physician Information: One child's admission information was missing the physician information from the admission information during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(10))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: The health statement for three children's admission information was not available for review during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: The immunization record for one infant 9 month 9-month-old was not available for review during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups: Two milk bottles in the Infants Classroom was observed not having the infants's name labeled.     This was corrected when the director and caregiver was brought to attention and labeled the names of the infants during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups (26 TAC §746.2419(6))

occurrences.finding: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion: Three employee personnel file did not have the highschool diploma documentation to review for qualification during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion (26 TAC §746.1107(2))

occurrences.finding: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you hire someone: One caregiver who was hired on September 26th, 2022 did not have their initial background check submitted prior allowing this caregiver to be at the operation.     This was corrected when the director entered the background check information for the employee during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you hire someone (26 TAC §745.621(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Three infants feeding instructions was observed have not been recertify since September 2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Directors 30- Annual Training: The annual training documentation for the director was observed missing 12 hours out of 30 training hours required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Directors 30- Annual Training (26 TAC §746.1301(6)(A))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Suspension and Expulsion: The operational policices was observed missing the suspension and expulsion during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Suspension and Expulsion (26 TAC §746.501(a)(8))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers -  24 Annual Training: Annual training docuementation for one caregiver was observed expired in September 2022.
